market.question: NFL regular-season win totals
market.resolutionText:
If the San Francisco pro football team has more than 10 wins in the 2025-26 regular season, then the market resolves to Yes.

Ties do not count as wins.

label.marketTitle: NFL regular-season win totals (e.g., San Francisco 49ers over 10.5 wins)
label.whatHappened: After the 2025 season, Kalshi initially graded multiple win-total markets incorrectly: a trader holding YES on 49ers over 10.5 (team won 12) was refunded only the original stake rather than paid the $1 contract value, and Kalshi announced this as 'the final result.' On Jan 7, 2026 journalist Dustin Gouker posted Discord screenshots that went viral (1.18M+ views); by the morning of Jan 8 Kalshi reversed, stating users holding correct YES positions 'shall be paid out their full contract settlement value of $1,' and credited the difference. The error affected many win-total markets, not just the 49ers.
